sections.title: Complete Liturgy and Anaphora of St. Dioscorus
sections.title_am: ሙሉ ሥርዓተ ቅዳሴና የቅዱስ ዲዮስቆሮስ ቅዳሴ

verses.text_geez: ሚጥዎተ ፡ ማርያም ፡ ዘቲ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ ወዕጽብተ ፡ ዘቲ ፡ ሰዓተ ፡ እንተ ፡ ባቲ ፡ ይወርድ ፡ መንፈስ ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ እመላዕልተ ፡ ሰማያት ፡ ወይጸልሉ ፡ ለዝንቱ ፡ መሥዋዕት ፡ ወይቄድሶ ። በጽሙና ፡ ወበፍርሃት ፡ ቁሙ ፡ ወጸልዩ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሰላሙ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ የሀሉ ፡ ምስሌየ ፡ ወምስለ ፡ ኲልክሙ ።
verses.text_am: ይህች ቀን ምን ያህል የምታስፈራ ናት ፤ ይህችስ ሰዓት ምን ያህል የምታስጨንቅ ናት ፤ መንፈስ ቅዱስ ከሰማየ ሰማያት የሚወርድባት፤
verses.text_en: How awesome is this day and how marvelous this hour wherein the Holy Spirit will descend from heaven
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: እምነ በ፥፥ ቅድስት ቤተክርስቲያን፥ ስርጉት አረፋቲሃ ወሥዕልት ወሠእልት በእንቁ ጳዝአን፤ እምነ በ፥፥ ቅድስት ቤተ ክርስቲያን፤
verses.text_am: ሰላም ላንቺ ይሁን፥ እናታችን ቤተ ክርስቲያንቾ ግድግዳዎችሸ በጳዝአን ዕንቁ የተጌጡ ናቸው፤ ሰላም ላንቺ ይሁን እናታችን ክብርት ቤተ ክርስቲያን
verses.text_en: Peace be unto you, our mother, O honorable church. Thy walls are embroidered with Topaz. Peace be unto you, out mother, O honorable church
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: መስቀል አብርሃ! በከዋክብት አሠርገወ ሰማየ፤ አምኩሉሰ ፀሐየ አርአየህ መስቀል አብርሃ! በከዋክብት ዐሠርገወ ሰማየህ
verses.text_am: መስቀል አበራ! በኮከቦች ሰማይን አስጌጠቾ ከሁሉም ፀ፥ይን አሳየህ መስቀል አበራቾ በኮከቦች ሰማይን አስጌጠ፥
verses.text_en: The cross shined and had the heavens embroidered with stars. Of all the sun is seen. The cross shined and had the heavens embroidered with stars.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ኩኩ ዘገብራ ከጽድቅ ጻድቅ ውእቱ ወዘያከብር ሰንበተ ኢይበክ ፈካሲ ዘገብአ ኀበ እግዚአብሔር ይፈክጠኒኑ እምሕዝቡ ኩኩ ዘገብራ ከጽድቅ ጻድቅ ውእቱ ወዘያከብር ሰንበተ
verses.text_am: በጎን የሚያደርግ ሰንበትንም የሚያከብር ሁኩ ጻድቅ ነውህ ወደ አግዚአብሔር አምክኮ የገባ መጻተኛ ከሕዝቡ ሁኩ ይከየኝ ይሆን? አይበክ በጎ ያደረገ ሰንበትንም የሚያከብር ጻድቅ ነውህ
verses.text_en: Blessed is he who does blessed deeds and honors the Sabbath. Let him not question whether he will be outcast from the multitudes if he was to enter into the worship of God. Blessed is he who does blessed deeds and honors the Sabbath.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_am: ሃኬ ኩያ እመቦ ብእሲ እምዕመናን ዘቦአ ቤተ ክርስቲያን በጊዜ ቅዳሴ ወኢሰምመ በጻሕፍተ ቅዱሳተ ወኢተአገሠ አስከ ይፌጽሙ ጸኩተ ቅዳሴ� ሃኬ ኩያ በቅዳሴ ጊዜ ከምዕመናን ወገን ወደ ቤተ ክርስቲያን የገባ ሰው ቢናር ቅዱሳት መጻሕፍትን ሰምቶ የቅዳሴውን ጸኩት እስኪጨርሱ ባይታገሥ ከቁርባን ባይቀበክ ከቤተ ክርስቲያን ይውጣ
verses.text_en: Halleluia! If there be anyone of the faithful that hath entered the church at the time of mass and hath not heard the holy Scriptures, and hath not waited until they finish the prayer of the Mass, and hath not received the holy communion, let him be driven out of the church:
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: ወኢተመጠወ እምቁርባን ይሰደድ እምቤተ ክርስተያን እሰመ አማሰነ ሕገ እግዚአብሔር ወአስተሐቀረ ቁመተ ቅድመ ንጉሥ ሰማያዊ ንጉሠ ሥጋ ወመንፈስ ከመዝ መሀሩነ ሐዋርያት በአብጥኪሶሙ
verses.text_am: የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ አፍርስዋክና የነፍስና የሥጋ ንጉሥ በሚሆን በሰማያዊ ንጉሥ በክርስቶስ ፊት መቆምን አቃኳክና ሐዋርያት በሲናዶሳቸው እንዲህ ሲኩ አሰተማሩን
verses.text_en: for he hath violated the law of God and disdained to stand before the heavenly King, the King of Body and Spirit. This the Apostles have taught us in their canons.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: አንቲ ውእቱ መሶበ ወርቅ ንጹሕ እንተ ውስቴታ መና ኅቡዕ ኅብስት ዘወረደ እም ሰማያት ወሀቤ
verses.text_am: ሕይወት ከኩኩ ዓከም የተሰወረ መና በውስጧ ያከባት የወርቅ መሶብ አንቺ ነሸህ ከሰማያት የወረደ ሕብስት ከሰው ሁኩ ድኅነት የሚሰጥ
verses.text_en: Thou art the pot of pure gold wherein is hidden the manna, the bread which came down from heaven giving life unto all the world.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ፳ዱ አብ ቅዱስ ፳ዱ ወክድ ቅዱስ ፳ዱ ውእቱ መንፈስ ቅዱስህ
verses.text_am: አንዱ አብ ቅዱስ ነው፤ አንዱ ወክድ ቅዱስ ነው፤ አንዱ መንፈስ ቅዱስም ቅዱስ ነውህ
verses.text_en: One is the Holy Father, one is the Holy Son, one is the Holy Spirit.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: በአማን አብ ቅዱስ በአማን ወክድ ቅዱስ በአማን ውእቱ መንፈስ ቅዱስህ
verses.text_am: አብ በእውነት ቅዱስ ነው፤ ወክድም በእውነት ቅዱስ ነው፤ መንፈስ ቅዱስም በእውነት ቅዱስ ነውህ
verses.text_en: Truly the Father is holy, truly the Son is holy, truly the Holy Spirit is holy.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_am: ሰብሕዎ ከእግዚአብሔር ኩክክሙ አሕዛብ ምእመናን ሁካችሁም እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑት
verses.text_en: Praise the Lord, all ye nations.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ወይሴብሕዎ ኩኩሙ ሕዝብ
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ሁኩ ያመሰግኑታክ
verses.text_en: And praise Him, all ye people.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: እስመ ጸንዓት ምሕረቱ ካዕኬነ ምሕረቱ በእኛ ካይ ጸንታከችና
verses.text_en: For His merciful kindness is great toward us.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ጽድጐሰ ከእግዚአብሔር ይሄኩ ከዓከም የእግዚአብሔር ቸርነት ከዘከዓከም ጸንቶ ናራክና ህ
verses.text_en: And the Truth of the Lord endureth for ever.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: ሆካህኑን በመከተል ህዝቡ ይህንን ይድገምለ
verses.text_am: ስብሐት ከአብራ ወወክድራ ወመንፈስ ቅዱስ ከአብ ከወክድ ከመንፈስ ቅዱስ ክብር ምስጋና ይገባክ
verses.text_en: Glory be to the Father and to the Son and to the Holy Spirit
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ሆካህኑን በመከተል ህዝቡ ይህንን ይድገምለ
verses.text_am: ይእዜኒ ወዘክፈኒ ወከዓከመ ዓከም አሜን ሃኬ ኩያ ዛ፤ም ዘወትርም ከዘከዓከሙ አሜን ሃኬ ኩያ
verses.text_en: Both now and ever and world without end. Amen.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_am: ተንሥኡ ከጸኩት ከጸኩት ተነሱ
verses.text_en: Stand up for prayer.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: እግዚኦ ተግሃከነ አቤቱ ይቅር በከን

verses.text_am: ሰካም ከኩክክሙ ሰካም ከሁካችሁ ይሁን

verses.text_en: - Master, Lord God Almighty, the Father of our Lord and our God and our Savior Jesus Christ, we render Thee thanks upon everything, for everything and in everything, for Thou hast covered us and succored us, hast kept us and brought us nigh, and received us unto Thyself, and undertaken our defense, and strengthened us and brought us unto this hour.

verses.text_en: -"The prayer of Oblation" of the Apostles. And again let us beseech the Almighty Lord, the Father of the Lord our Savior Jesus Christ, on behalf of those who bring an oblation within the one holy universal church, a sacrifice, first-fruits, tithes, a thank offering, a memorial, whether much or little, in secret or openly, and of those who wish to give and have not wherewith to give, that He accept their ready mind, that He vouchsafe to them the heavenly kingdom; power over all works of blessing belongs to the Lord our God.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ንፍቅ ዲያቆን

verses.text_en: Pray for them who bring an oblation.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_am: ተወከፍ መባኦሙ ከአኃው ወተወከፍ መባኦን ከአኃት ከነኒ ተወከፍ መባአነ ወ�ርባነነ የወንዶችን መባ ተቀበክ የሴቶችን መባ ተቀበክህ የኛንም መባችንን ቁርባናችንን ተቀበክክንህ
verses.text_en: Accept the oblation of our brethren, accept the oblation of our sisters, and ours also accept, our oblation and our offering.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_en: - Lord our God who art Almighty, we pray Thee and beseech Thee for them that bring an oblation within the one holy universal church, a sacrifice, first-fruits, tithes, a thank offering, a memorial, whether much or little, in secret or openly, and for those who wish to give and have not wherewith to give.
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_en: Thy acceptance of their ready mind grant Thou unto every one: let the recompense of blessing be a portion to all of them: through Thy only begotten Son, through whom to Thee with Him and with the Holy Spirit be glory and dominion, both now and ever and world without end. Amen.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_am: ተንሥኡ ከጸኩት ከጸኩት ተነሱ
verses.text_en: Stand up for prayer.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: እግዚኦ ተግሃከነ አቤቱ ይቅር በከን
verses.text_en: Lord have mercy upon us.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ሰካም ከኩክክሙ ሰካም ከሁካችሁ ይሁን
verses.text_en: Peace be unto you all.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ምስከ መንፈስከ ከመንፈስህ ጋር
verses.text_en: And with Thy spirit.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ኬ የኅብስት ጸኩት
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: መምህ፤ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሆይ ከቀዳማዊ አብ ጋራ አንድ የምትሆንራ ንጹሕ የሚሆን የአብ ቃልራ የማሕየዊ መንፈስ ቅዱስም ቃልራ ከሰማያት የወረድህ የሕይወት ኅብስት አንተ ነህ ስለ ዓለሙ መዳን ነውር የሌለበት መስዋዕት እንድትሆን መናገርን አስቀደምህ
verses.text_en: - ("The prayer of Oblation.") O my Master, Jesus Christ, co-eternal pure Word of the Father, and Word of the Holy Spirit, the life giver, Thou art the bread of life which didst come down from heaven, and didst foretell that Thou wouldest be the Lamb without Spot for the life of the world:
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: አሁንም ከበጎነትህ ቸርነት እንለምናለን እንማልዳለንም ሰው ወዳጅ ሆይ ያንተ በሚሆን በዚህ በመንፈሳዊ ታቦት ላይ ባኖርነው በዚህ ኅብስት ላይና በዚህ ጽዋ ላይ ፊትህን ግለፅ ይህንን ኅብስት ባርከውራ ይህንንም ጽዋ አክብረው ሁለቱንም አንጻቸው
verses.text_en: We now pray and beseech of Thine excellent goodness, O lover of man, make Thy face to shine upon this bread, and upon this cup, which we have set upon this spiritual ark of Thine: Bless this bread, and hallow this cup, and cleanse them both.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ይህ ንጹሕ ሥጋህን ይሆን ዘንድ ለውጠውራ በዚህ ጽዋ ውስጥ የተቀዳውም ወይን የከበረ ደምህን ይሁን ለሁላችንም ያረገ ለነፍሳችንና ለሥጋችን ለልቡናችንም ፈውስ ይሆን ዘንድ
verses.text_en: And change this bread to become Thy pure body, and what is mingled in this cup to become Thy precious blood, let them be offered for us all for healing and for the salvation of our soul and our body and our spirit.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: አምላካችን ክርስቶስ የሁላችን ንጉሥ አንተ ነህ፤ ከፍ ያለ ምስጋናንና ክብርን ስግደትንም ለአንተ እንልካለን ቸር ከሚሆን ከሰማያዊ አባትህ ጋራ ከአንተ ጋራ ከሚተካከል ከማሕየዊ መንፈስ ቅዱስም ጋራ ዛ፤ም ዘወትርም ለዘላለሙ፤አሜን
verses.text_en: Thou art the King of us all, Christ our God, and to Thee we send up high praise and glory and worship, with Thy good heavenly Father and the Holy Spirit, the life giver, who is co-equal with Thee, both now and ever and world without end. Amen.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ይህ የአባቶቻችን የሐዋርያት ትእዛዝ ነውህ ሰው በልቦናው ቂምንና በቀልን ቅንዓትንና ጠብን በባልንጀራው ላይ በማንም ላይ ቢሆን አይያዝህ
verses.text_en: This is the order of our fathers the Apostles: Let none Keep in his heart malice or revenge or envy or hatred towards his neighbor, or towards any other body.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ስግዱ ከእግዚአብሔር በፍርሃት በፍርሃት ሁናችሁ ከእግዚአብሔር ስገዱ
verses.text_en: Worship the Lord with fear.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ቅድሜከ እግዚኦ ንሰግድ ወንሴብሐከ አቤቱ እያመሰገንህ ከፊትህ እንሰግዳከን ተንበርከኩ
verses.text_en: Before Thee, Lord, we worship, and Thee do we glorify. bow
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ጸኩት ሆፍትሐት ዘወክድከ
verses.text_en: The Absolution of the son. Master, Lord Jesus Christ, the Only- begotten Son, the Word of God the Father, who hast broken off from us all the bonds of our sins through Thy life-giving and saving sufferings, who didst breathe upon the face of Thy holy disciples and pure ministers saying to them: Receive the Holy Spirit: whatsoever man's sins ye remit they are remitted unto them, and whatsoever sins ye retain they are retained:
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_en: Thou therefore, O Lord, hast now granted the priesthood to Thy pure ministers that do the priests; office at all times in Thy holy church that they may remit sin on earth, may bind and loosen all the bonds of iniquity. Now again we pray and entreat of Thy goodness, O lover of man, on behalf of these Thy servants and handmaids, my fathers and my brothers and my sisters, and also on my own behalf, on me Thy feeble servant, and on behalf of them that bow their heads before Thy holy altar:
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_en: prepare for us the way of Thy mercy, break and sever all the bonds of our sins, whether we have trespassed against Thee, O Lord, wittingly or unwittingly or in deceit or in evilness of heart, whether in deed or in work or through smallness of understanding, for Thou knowest the feebleness of man. O good lover of man and Lord of all creation, grant us, O Lord, forgiveness of our sins, bless us and purify us and set us free and absolve all Thy people and fill us with the fear of Thy name, and establish us in the doing of Thy holy will.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_en: Now again we pray and entreat of Thy goodness, O lover of man, on behalf of these Thy servants and handmaids, my fathers and my brothers and my sisters, and also on my own behalf, on me Thy feeble servant, and on behalf of them that bow their heads before Thy holy altar: prepare for us the way of Thy mercy, break and sever all the bonds of our sins, whether we have trespassed against Thee, O Lord, wittingly or unwittingly or in deceit or in evilness of heart,
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_en: whether in deed or in work or through smallness of understanding, for Thou knowest the feebleness of man. O good lover of man and Lord of all creation, grant us, O Lord, forgiveness of our sins, bless us and purify us and set us free and absolve all Thy people and fill us with the fear of Thy name, and establish us in the doing of Thy holy will. O Good, for Thou art our Lord and our God and our Savior Jesus Christ, to Thee we send glory and honor with Thy good
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_en: heavenly Father, and Holy Spirit, the life- giver, who is co-equal with Thee, both now and ever and world without end. Amen. May Thy servants who serve on this day, the priest and the deacon and the clergy and all the people, and I myself Thy poor servant, be absolved and set free and cleansed out of the mouth of the Holy Trinity, the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit, and out of the mouth of the one holy apostolic church, and out of the mouths of the fifteen prophets, and out of the
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_en: mouths of the twelve apostles, and out of the mouths of the seventy-two disciples the ministers, and out of the mouth of the speaker of divinity, the evangelist Mark the apostle and martyr: O Good, for Thou art our Lord and our God and our Savior Jesus Christ, to Thee we send glory and honor with thy good heavenly Father, and Holy Spirit, the life- giver, who is co-equal with Thee, both now and ever and world without end. Amen.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_en: May Thy servants who serve on this day, the priest and the deacon and the clergy and all the people, and I myself thy poor servant, be absolved and set free and cleansed out of the mouth of the holy Trinity, the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit, and out of the mouth of the one holy apostolic church, and out of the mouths of the fifteen prophets, and out of the mouths of the twelve apostles, and out of the mouths of the seventy-two disciples the ministers, and out of the mouth of the
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_en: speaker of divinity, the evangelist Mark the apostle and martyr: and out of the mouths of the honored Patriarchs St. Serverus and St. Dioscorus and St. Athanasius and St. John Chrysostom and St. Cyril and St. Gregory and St. Basil: and out of the mouths of the 318 orthodox that assembled in Nicaea to condemn Arius, and out of the mouths of the 150 that assembled in Constantinople to condemn Macedonius,
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_en: and out of the mouth of the 200 that assembled in Ephesus to condemn Nestor, and out of the mouth of the honored Patriarch and the blessed Archbishop , and out of the mouth of me also the sinful and miserable and poor, O may they be absolved and set free, and out of the mouth of our Lady Holy Mary, of twofold virginity, mother of God, the new loom; for Thy holy name is blessed and full of glory, O holy Trinity, Father and Son and Holy Spirit, both now and ever and world without end. Amen.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_am: ዲያቆኑ ሲጸልይ ሕዝቡ በመከተል በየምዕራፉ «አሜን ኪራካይሶን አቤቱ ይቅር በከን» ይበክ
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: አንድ ስከምታደርግ ሥጋውና ደሙ እግዚአብሔር በይቅርታው አንድ ያደርገን ዘንድ ሰካምን እንማክዳከን
verses.text_en: For the peace holy things we beseech, that God may grant us peace through His Mercy
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: እግዚአብሔር የሱን ሃይማናት በንጹሕ እንድንጠብቅ ይሰጠን ዘንድ ስከ ሃይማናታችን እንማክዳከን
verses.text_am: እስከ ፍጻሜያችን ድረስ እግዚአብሔር በመንፈስ ቅዱስ አንድነት ይጠብቀን ዘንድ ስከ አንድነታችን እንማክዳከን
verses.text_en: For our Faith we beseech, that God may grant us to keep the faith in purity. For our congregation we beseech, that God may keep us unto the end in the communion of the Holy Spirit.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: በመከራችን ሁኩ እግዚአብሔር የትዕግሥትን ፍጻሜ ይሰጠን ዘንድ ስከ ነፍሳችን ትዕግሥት እንማክዳከን
verses.text_am: ቅዱሳን ስከሚሆኑ ነቢያት ከሳቸው ጋራ እግዚአብሔር ይ�ጥረን ዘንድ እንማክዳከን
verses.text_en: For patience of soul we beseech, that God may vouchsafe us perfect patience in all our tribulation For the holy prophets we beseech, that God may number us with them.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: እነሱ ደስ እንዳሰኙት ደስ ክናሰኘው እግዚአብሔር ሆማገክገኩንከ ይሰጠን ዘንድ ዕድክ ፈንታቸውንም ያድከን ዘንድ አገክጋአች ስከሚሆኑ ሐዋርያት እንማክዳከን
verses.text_am: እግዚአብሔር ከኛ የሰማዕትነትን ሥራ ይሰጠን ዘንድ ቅዱሳን ስከሚሆኑ ሰማዕታት እንማክዳከን
verses.text_en: For the ministering Apostles we beseech, that God may grant us to be well pleasing even as they were well pleasing, apportion unto us a lot with them. For the Holy martyrs we beseech, that God may grant us to perfect the same conversation.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: የቤተ ክርስቲያን አገክጋአች እነሱ ናቸውና እግዚአብሔር እነሱን ከረጅም ወራት ይሰጠን ዘንድ
verses.text_am: ያከ ነውር በንጽሕና ሆነው በዕውቀት የሃይማናትን ቃክ ያቀኑ ዘንድ ስከ ርእሰ ኪቃነ ጳጳሳቱ ብፁዕ ስከሚሆን ስከ ኪቀ ጳጳሳችንም እንማክዳከን
verses.text_en: For our Patriarch and the blessed Archbishop we beseech, that grant them length of days to be over us, that with understanding they may rightly speak the word of faith in purity without spot for that they are the defenders of the church.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_am: የክህነትን ሥክጣን ከእነሱ እግዚአብሔር እንዳያርቅ መትጋትን እሱን መፍራትንም እስከ ፍባሜ ይሰጥክን ዘንድ ድካማቸውንም ይቀበክ ዘንድ ስከ ቀሳውስት እንማክዳከን
verses.text_en: For the priests we beseech, that God may never take from them the spirit of priesthood, and may give them the grace of zeal and fear of Him unto the end and accept their labor.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ፈጽመው ኪፋጠኑ መፋጠንን እግዚአብሔር ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ በቅድስናም ይቀርቡ ዘንድ ድካማቸውንና ፍቅራቸውንም ያስብ ዘንድ ስከ ዲያቆናት እንማክዳከን
verses.text_en: For the deacons we beseech, that God may grant them to run a perfect course, and draw them high unto Him in holiness, and remember their labor and their love.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: የሃይማናታቸውን ትጋት ኪፈጽሙ እግዚአብሔር ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ ስከ ንፍቀ ዲያቆናት ስከ አንባቢዎችም ስከ መዘምራንም እንማክዳከን
verses.text_en: For the assistant deacons and the anagnosts and the singers we beseech, that God grant them to perfect the diligence of their faith.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ክመናቸውን ይሰማቸው ዘንድ ይክቁንም የመንፈስ ቅዱስን ሀብት በክቡናቸው ያሳድርባቸው ዘንድ ድካማቸውንም ይቀበክ ዘንድ ስከ ባክቴቶች ረዳትም ስከኬካቸው እንማክዳከን
verses.text_en: For the widows and the bereaved we beseech, that God may hear their prayers and vouchsafe them abundantly in their hearts the grace of the Holy Spirit and accept their labor.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: እግዚአብሔር የድንግክናቸውን ዋጋ ሆአክኪክከ ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ ከእግዚአብሔርም ወንዶችም ሴቶች ክጆች ይሆኑት ዘንድ ድካማቸውንም ይቀበክ ዘንድ ስከ ደናግክ እንማክዳከን
verses.text_en: For the virgins we beseech, that God may grant them the crown of virginity, and that they may be unto God sons and daughters and that He may accept their labor.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: በመታገግቸው ዋጋቸውን ይቀበኩ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር እንዲሰጣቸው ስከ ሚታገሁ ሰዎች እንማክዳከን
verses.text_en: For those who suffer patiently we beseech, that God grant them to receive their rewards through patience.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: በንጽሕና ሆነው ይጠብቁ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ሃይማናትን እንዲሰጣቸው ስከ ሕዝባውያንና ስከ መሃይምናን እንማክዳከን
verses.text_en: For the laity and faithful we beseech, that God may grant them complete faith which they may keep in purity.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: በጎውን ዕድክ ኃጢአትን ከማስተሥረይ ሁከተኛ መወከድ የሚገኝበትን ሕፅበት እግዚአብሔር ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ በቅድስት ሥካሴም ማኅተም ያከብራቸው ያትማቸው ዘንድ ስከ ንኡሰ ክርስቲያን እንማክዳከን
verses.text_en: For the catechumens we beseech, that God may grant them a good portion and the washing of regeneration for the remission of sin, and seal them with the seal of the Holy Trinity.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: በዘመኑ ፍፁም ሰካምን እግዚአብሔር ይሰጣት ዘንድ እግዚአብሔርን ስከምትወድ ስከ አገራችን ኢትአጵያ እንማክዳከን
verses.text_am: ዕውቀትን እሱን መፍራትንም እግዚአብሔር ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ ስከ መኳንንትና ሥክጣን ስካካቸው እንማክዳከን
verses.text_en: For our country Ethiopia we beseech, that God may give her peace forever. For the rulers and those in authority we beseech, that God may grant them of His wisdom and His fear.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_am: ስከዓከሙ ሁኩ እግዚአብሔር ማሰብን ያስቀድም ዘንድ ከእያንዳንዱም የሚያስፈክገውን ያማረውን የሚሻውንም ያስብ ዘንድ ስከ ዓከም ሁኩ እንማክዳከን
verses.text_en: For the whole world we beseech, that God should hasten His purpose and put into the mind of all and each to desire that which is good and expedient.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: እግዚአብሔር ይቅርታ ባከው ቀኝ መርቶ በፍቅርና በደኅንነት ወደ ማደሪያቸው ይመክሳቸው ዘንድ በባሕርና በደረቅ ስከሚሄዱ ሰዎች እንማክዳከን
verses.text_en: For them that travel by sea and by land we beseech, that God should guide them with a merciful right hand and let them enter their home in safety and peace.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: እግዚአብሔር የዕከት የዕከት ምግባቸውን ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ ስከ ተራቡና ስከ ተጠሙ ሰዎች እንማክዳከን
verses.text_am: እግዚአብሔር ፈጽሞ ያረጋጋቸው ዘንድ ስከ አዘኑና ስከ ተከዙ ሰዎች እንማክዳከን
verses.text_en: For the hungry and the thirsty we beseech, that God should grant them their daily food. For the sad and the sorrowful we beseech, that God may give them perfect consolation
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_geez: እግዚአብሔር ከእሥራታቸው ይፈታቸው ዘንድ ስከ ታሠሩ ሰዎች እንማክዳከን
verses.text_am: እግዚአብሔር በሰካም ወደ አገራቸው ይመክሳቸው ዘንድ ስከ ተማረኩ ሰዎች እንማክዳከን
verses.text_en: For the prisoners we beseech, that God may loose them from their bonds. For the captives we beseech, that God may restore them to their county in peace.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_am: እግዚአብሔር ትዕግሥትን በጎ ትምህርትንም ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ የድካማቸውንም ፍፁም ዋጋ ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ ስከ ተሰደዱ ሰዎች እንማክዳከን
verses.text_en: For those who were sent away we beseech, that God should grant them patience and good instruction, and give them complete reward for their labor.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: እግዚአብሔር ፈጥና ያድናቸው ዘንድ ይቅርታውንና ቸርነቱንም ይክክካቸው ዘንድ ስከ ታመሙትና ስከ ድውያኑ እንማክዳከን
verses.text_en: For the sick and the diseased we beseech, that God should heal them speedily and send upon them mercy and compassion.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ከቅድስት ቤተ ክርስቲያን ወገን ስከ ሞቱ ሰዎች እግዚአብሔር የዕረፍት ቦታ ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ እንማክዳከን
verses.text_en: For those who have fallen asleep in his holy church we beseech, that God may vouchsafe them a place to rest.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: እግዚአብሔር እንዳይቀየማቸው ከመዓትም ተመክሶ ፍጹም ዕረፍትን ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ ስከ በደኩ አባቶቻችንና ወንድሞቻችን እንማክዳከን
verses.text_en: For those who have sinned, our fathers and our brothers we beseech, that God cherish not anger against them, but grant them rest and relief from His wrath.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: በሚሻበት ቦታ እግዚአብሔር ዝናቡን ያዘንብ ዘንድ ስከ ዝናብ እንማክዳከን
verses.text_am: የወንዙን ውኃ ሙካክን ብከን እግዚአብሔር እነሱን እሰከ ክካቸውና እሰከ ወሰናቸው ይሞካ ዘንድ ስከ ወንዝ ውኃ እንማክዳከን
verses.text_en: For the rains we beseech, that God may send rain on the place that needs it. For the water of the rivers we beseech, that God should fill them unto their due measure and bounds.
verses.source_note: carried

verses.text_am: ከዘርና ከመከር ኪሆን እግዚአብሔር ከምድር ፍ፤ዋን ይሰጣት ዘንድ ስከ ምድር ፍ፤ እንማክዳከን
verses.text_en: For the fruits of the earth we beseech, that God may grant to the earth her fruit for sowing and for harvest.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: በጸኩት የምንከምንና የምንማክድ ሁካችንንም በሰካም በመንፈስ ይጠብቀንራ ፍቅርንም ይስጠን ዐይነክቡናችንንም ያብራክንራ ፈቃዱም ሆና ጸኩታችንን ይቀበክ ዘንድ ቀርበን እግዚአብሔርን እንከምነው
verses.text_en: And all of us who ask and beseech in prayer, may He cover us with the spirit of peace, and give us grace, and enlighten the eyes of our hearts. Let us draw high and ask God to accept our prayers according to His will.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: አውቀን በሀብቱ እናድግ ዘንድ በእርሱም ስም እንመካ ዘንድ በነቢያት በሐዋርያትም መሠረት ካይ እንታነፅ ዘንድ እንግዲህ በመንፈስ ቅዱስ እንነግ ቀርበን አምካካችን እግዚአብሔርን እንከምነው ወዶ ጸኩታችንን ይቀበክ ዘንድ
verses.text_en: Let us therefore rise in the Holy Spirit, growing in His grace, with understanding, glorying in His name and built upon the foundation of the prophets and the apostles. Let us draw high and ask Lord God to accept our prayers according to His will.
verses.source_note: carried; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ተንሥኡ ከጸኩት ከጸኩት ተነሱ
verses.text_en: Stand up for prayer.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: እግዚኦ ተግሃከነ አቤቱ ይቅር በከን
verses.text_en: Lord have mercy upon us.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ሰካም ከኩክክሙ ሰካም ከሁካችሁ ይሁን
verses.text_en: Peace be unto you all.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ምስከ መንፈስከ ከመንፈስህ ጋር
verses.text_en: And with thy spirit.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ንስግድ ሆ፻ ጊዜከ እንስገድ ሆማ ጊዜከ
verses.text_en: Let's worship (to be repeated thrice )
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ከአብ ወወክድ ወመንፈስ ቅዱስ እንዘ ሠከስቱ አሐዱ ሆ፻ ጊዜከ ሦስት ሲሆኑ አንድ ከሚሆኑ ከአብና ከወክድ ከመንፈስ ቅዱስም ሆማ ጊዜከ
verses.text_en: The Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit, three in one. (to be repeated thrice)
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ሰካም ከኪ ሰካምታ ይገባሻክ
verses.text_en: Peace be unto thee:
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ቅድስት ቤተ ክርስቲያን ማኅደረ መከኮት የመከኮት ማደሪያ ቅድስት ቤተ ክርስቲያን
verses.text_en: Holy church, dwelling-place of the Godhead.
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ሰአኪ ከነ ከምኝክን
verses.text_en: Ask for us:
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: ድንግክ ማርያም ወካዲተ አምካክ አምካክን የወከድሸ ድንግክ ማርያም
verses.text_en: Virgin Mary, mother of God,
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_am: አንቲ ውእቱ አንቺ ነሸ
verses.text_en: Thou art:
verses.source_note: label; source does not distinguish or separate Ge'ez and Amharic text

verses.text_geez: ማዕጠንት ዘወርቅ እንተ ፆርኪ ፍሕመ እሳት ቡሩክ ዘነሥአ እመቅደስ
verses.text_am: ብሩክ ከቤተ መቅደስ የተቀበካት የእሳትን ፍሕም የተሸከምሸ የወርቅ ጥና አንቺ ነሸ
verses.text_en: the golden censer which didst bear the coal of fire which the blessed took from the sanctuary,
verses.source_note: label

verses.text_geez: ዘይሠሪ ኃጢአተ ወይደመስስ ጌጋየ ዝውእቱ ዘእግዚአብሔር ቃክ ዘተሰብአ እምኔኪ ዘአዕረገ ከአቡሁ ርእሶ ዕጣነ ወመሥዋዕተ ሥሙረ
verses.text_am: ኃጢአትን የሚያስተሰርይ በደክንም የሚያጠፋ ይኸውም ካንቺ ሰው የሆነ የእግዚአብሔር ቃክ ነውህ
verses.text_en: and which forgiveth sin and blotteth out error, who is God's Word that was made man from thee, who offered Himself to his Father for incense and an acceptable sacrifice.
verses.source_note: carried
